messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for `inference-service` (P1) — sustained high 5xx rate in us-west1. Link: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/PD-4990012345. Auto-escalation in 3m.

pagerduty-bot: Alert routed to rotation: alice (oncall). Incident key: PD-4990012345.

alice (oncall): I'm on it — calling in SREs. @bob (sre) @carol (infra) can you triage logs and LB metrics? :phone:

bob (sre): seeing a spike in 502/503 from nginx LB -> upstream connection resets. Quick tail: "upstream: connection reset by peer" across many pods. Looks like backend workers are saturating KV cache/queue. Pushing logs to gist: https://internal.logs/4990012345-snippet

carol (infra): recent network/conn-limit change rolled out in us-west1 last night (infra-rollout/1727). Will diff config now. Suspect `worker_conn_max` change caused backlog.

alice (oncall): can we throttle or divert traffic while we fix? Any quick mitigation: scale, fallback model, or route to eu?

bob (sre): scaling first. Bumping replicas and enabling circuit-breaker. Running:

```
kubectl -n prod scale deployment inference --replicas=8
kubectl -n prod rollout status deployment/inference --watch
```

bob (sre): also enabling fallback routing to `inference-light` variant for us-west1 (will route 30% traffic) — sending config patch now.

dave (support): Customer impact: two enterprise customers (ACME corp #8672, Datapulse #8673) reported timeouts and errors. I'm DM'ing them with an acknowledgement + ETA.

alice (oncall): good. ETA ~12m for scale and routing patch to stabilize. Keep me posted on errors/sec and latency percentiles. :thumbsup:

bob (sre): scaled to 8 replicas (done), fallback routing patch applied (canary 30%). Quick check: 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 6% over last 90s.

carol (infra): rolling back the conn-limit change in us-west1 (reverted infra-rollout/1727) — patch applied.

alice (oncall): observing error rate continuing to decline; latency returning to normal. I'll keep the page open for 10 more minutes of steady metrics, then close. @erin (pm) please capture for postmortem.

erin (pm): noted — creating incident ticket and PM notes. Will pull config diffs and capture customer comms.

bob (sre): verifying pod logs for any lingering OOMs or restarts. Nothing else obvious. Marking mitigation steps in incident doc.

alice (oncall): thanks team — great coordination. Leaving this thread for now; will update before closing PD. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: PagerDuty alert acknowledged by alice (oncall) at 4990012352. Manual close pending 10m stability window.
